meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会引导操作者创建第一个NanoClaw agent：选频道、收集身份信息、运行脚本把DM消息组连到新agent，并通过正常投递路径发送欢迎DM验证链路。
howto.when: 在频道凭据已配置、服务运行后，当操作者要求创建第一个DM agent时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个NanoClaw agent
say.note: Claude会开始引导你完成配置和验证。

say.text: 把DM频道接入新agent并测试欢迎消息
say.note: Claude会收集你的ID并运行脚本发送DM。

say.text: 设置第一个agent，发条欢迎DM验证
say.note: Claude会按步骤创建agent并验证链路。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude guides the operator to create the first NanoClaw agent: pick a channel, collect identity info, run a script that links the DM messaging group to the new agent, and send a welcome DM through the normal delivery path to verify the pipeline.
howto.when_en: After channel credentials are set and the service runs, when the operator requests initializing the first DM agent.

say_en.note: Claude will walk you through setup and verification.

say_en.text: Wire the DM channel to a new agent and test the welcome DM.
say_en.note: Claude will collect your IDs and run the script.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent and send a welcome DM to verify.
say_en.note: Claude will create the agent and confirm delivery.
